newsitem.title: USA: Rexene says elects two directors.
newsitem.headline: Rexene says elects two directors.

text.p: Rexene Corp said Wednesday that Stephen Swid and Richard Perry have been elected to the company's board, effective immediately.

Entities affiliated with these two new independent directors own in the aggregate approximately 1.2 million shares of Rexene common stock, or about 6 percent of the outstanding shares of Rexene common stock.
Swid, 56, is chairman and chief executive of SCS Communications, which owns and operates diverse media properties.
Perry, 42, is President of Perry Corp, a New York based private investment management firm.
